W.note: Clean, fast glow and lift with solid focus and reduced-motion handling, but 180-480ms feels crisp more than ethereal.

X.note: Pastel halo with blur bloom, overshoot bezier and long soft return reads truly dreamy, with a tidy card layout, focus ring and reduced-motion.

Y.note: Rich mist, blur halo, sheen and pointer-following glow are ethereal, but 1-2s durations, animated filter blur and a small label cost practicality, and the hover frames missed the button.

Z.note: Competent sheen sweep with focus and reduced-motion, but a sheen artifact sits on the button at rest and the effect is more shiny than dreamlike.
